mapper.sql: log_id, user_id, user_name, login_status, login_ip, user_agent, message, login_time, create_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName}
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableName} LIKE sys_login_log
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( user_id, user_name, login_status, login_ip, user_agent, message, login_time, create_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{log.userId}, #{log.userName}, #{log.loginStatus}, #{log.loginIp}, #{log.userAgent}, #{log.message}, #{log.loginTime}, #{log.createTime}, #{log.deleted} )
